label: The operation respect of a moving is relevant to that moving
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: whenever y moves x in respect r and that moving is y's operation in y's own respect o, y's being moved in o (if it is) is relevant to its moving x in r. On the enabling reading of relevance the route needs (docs/notes/caused-mover-cstar.md), this holds when the operation is itself the change by which y moves x: were y not being moved in o, it would not now be moving x in r. It adds the relevance clause that lets the operation route (f03798ba-e9d8-5594-b354-81fb9e9048c0 with d791628f-72c6-572e-ad1e-03f4f22ba646 and 0628359b-4a71-5c67-a84b-0fd80104aceb) yield b3573a61-ec8b-5aba-8b5f-f1d03611e7f6 for caused movers. Lean binding (not yet registered): forall y x r o, MovesIn y x r -> OperationOf y x r o -> RelevantTo y x r o, over the MotionMapsBatch1 parameters.
